shortDescription: Manage the capabilities for a Hyperledger Fabric channel

options.name: application
options.description: The application capability level for the channel. The value must be a valid application capability level supported by Hyperledger Fabric, and all peers in the channel being updated must support this application capability level. Example application capability levels include C(V1_4_2) and C(V2_0).

options.name: channel
options.description: The channel capability level. The value must be a valid channel capability level supported by Hyperledger Fabric, and all peers and ordering service nodes in the channel being updated must support this channel capability level. Example channel capability levels include C(V1_4_3) and C(V2_0).

options.name: orderer
options.description: The orderer capability level for the channel. The value must be a valid orderer capability level supported by Hyperledger Fabric, and all ordering service nodes in the channel being updated must support this orderer capability level. Example orderer capability levels include C(V1_4_2) and C(V2_0).

options.name: path
options.description: Path to current the channel configuration file. This file can be fetched by using the M(channel_config) module. This file will be updated in place. You will need to keep a copy of the original file for computing the configuration update.
